\section{\texttt{AgentAnswer}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.schemas.AgentAnswer}\label{schema:AgentAnswer}\index{Classes!AgentAnswer}

Final answer returned by the insight agent.
\apifield{Inherits}\texttt{BaseModel}
\apifield{Fields}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{question}] \texttt{str}, required
  \item[\texttt{answer}] \texttt{str}, required
  \item[\texttt{recommended\_\allowbreak{}actions}] \texttt{list[str]\allowbreak{}}, required
  \item[\texttt{citations}] \texttt{list[Citation]\allowbreak{}}, required
  \item[\texttt{route}] \texttt{str}, required
  \item[\texttt{confidence}] \texttt{float}, required
  \item[\texttt{guardrail}] \texttt{GuardrailDecision \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}
  \item[\texttt{tool\_\allowbreak{}run}] \texttt{ToolRunRecord \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}
  \item[\texttt{diagnostics}] \texttt{dict[str,\allowbreak{} Any]\allowbreak{}}, default \texttt{dict()\allowbreak{}}

\apifield{Details}\texttt{guardrail} records the deterministic safety decision made for the request, so API and CLI consumers can see whether the question was answered normally or refused (and why). \texttt{tool\_\allowbreak{}run} records the tool invoked for the question, if any, making tool use visible in the agent answer and the API response.
